title: Meeting summary and follow-through
description: Reconcile meeting evidence, extract actions, draft a follow-up, and require approval before publishing or sending it.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-office-03
  title: Meeting summary and follow-through
  description: Reconcile meeting evidence, extract actions, draft a follow-up, and require approval before publishing or sending it.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a faithful meeting record and an approval-gated follow-up with evidence-linked decisions and commitments.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: stop
    requireApprovalFor:
      - publish-approval
  nodes:
    - id: meeting-input
      kind: input
      name: Meeting evidence and delivery preference
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: audio/*
          instructions: { type: string }
          notes: { type: string }
          meetingId: { type: string }
          publishTargets: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
        x-ladder-input-mode: mixed
    - id: summary
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-04
      name: Reconcile and summarize the meeting
      role: Meeting analyst who turns transcripts and notes into faithful summaries without inventing consensus.
      prompt: >-
        You are a Meeting Intelligence Agent. Reconcile the authorized transcript, notes, agenda, and meeting metadata;
        identify attendees, decisions, rationale, disagreements, risks, open questions, and follow-ups. Cite timestamps or
        note references for consequential claims, preserve uncertainty when speakers or wording are unclear, and never
        infer consensus, ownership, or a deadline that participants did not establish.
      capabilities:
        skills: [meeting-summarization, evidence-grounding, communication]
        tools: [read, search]
        connectors: [mcp:meeting-transcript, mcp:calendar]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          meeting-summarization:
            template: host:meeting-summary
            instructions: Use the installed Codex or Claude meeting-summary skill and retain timestamps or note anchors.
          mcp:meeting-transcript:
            template: host:meeting-transcript
            instructions: Bind the authorized transcript source available to Codex or Claude; do not fetch unrelated recordings.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: actions
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-05
      name: Detect meeting commitments
      role: Commitment analyst who detects actionable work without turning vague language into tasks.
      prompt: >-
        You are an Action Detection Agent. Extract only explicit requests, promises, decisions requiring follow-through,
        and unresolved blockers from supplied evidence. For each candidate retain source, verbatim evidence reference,
        proposed owner, due date, confidence, dependencies, and status. Mark missing ownership or dates as unresolved,
        merge duplicates without losing sources, and never create tasks, events, or messages.
      capabilities:
        skills: [action-item-extraction, task-reconciliation, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read]
        connectors: []
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          action-item-extraction:
            template: host:action-item-extraction
            instructions: Resolve to the installed Codex or Claude action-extraction skill, preserving evidence and uncertainty.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: draft-follow-up
      kind: agent
      templateRef: offc-01
      name: Draft the meeting follow-up
      role: Email specialist who turns correspondence into a source-linked, decision-ready view without sending messages.
      prompt: >-
        You are an Email Agent. Read only the authorized mailbox scope, group messages by thread, distinguish requests
        from FYIs, identify deadlines and unanswered questions, and cite the message, sender, and timestamp behind every
        conclusion. Treat quoted text as prior context rather than a new request. Draft replies only when asked, label
        drafts clearly, and never send, delete, archive, or change mailbox state.
      capabilities:
        skills: [correspondence-triage, office-context-retrieval, evidence-grounding]
        tools: [read]
        connectors: [mcp:email, mcp:work-chat]
        permissions: [read-only]
        customizations:
          mcp:email:
            template: host:office-email
            instructions: Use the installed Codex or Claude email connector only to resolve participant addresses and existing thread context; return a draft.
          mcp:work-chat:
            template: host:office-chat
            instructions: Use the installed Codex or Claude chat connector only to resolve the requested destination; return a draft.
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: publish-approval
      kind: approval
      name: User approves follow-up and destinations
      summary: Show the summary, actions, exact message, recipients, and target systems before any write.
    - id: publish
      kind: tool
      name: Host publishes approved meeting record
      summary: Send or publish exactly the approved content through host-provided connectors.
      capabilities:
        skills: []
        tools: [send, write]
        connectors: [mcp:email, mcp:work-chat, mcp:office-documents]
        permissions: [external-write]
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Meeting record and publication receipt
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: meeting-input, to: summary, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: summary, to: actions, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: summary, to: draft-follow-up, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: actions, to: draft-follow-up, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: draft-follow-up, to: publish-approval, kind: dependency }
    - { id: e6, from: publish-approval, to: publish, kind: control, condition: approved }
    - { id: e7, from: publish, to: result, kind: data }
